{"consolidated_memory":"## Silent Drop Issues in notifications/push/dispatch.py — Two Separate Incidents

### Occasion 1: 2026-05-05 (Timezone Bug)
- **File**: notifications/push/dispatch.py
- **Problem**: Silent drop in the dispatcher
- **Reproduction**: Dispatch to a device token that was rotated
- **Signal**: A send that reports success with no delivery
- **Trigger**: Only appeared on the first request after a cold start
- **Root Cause**: A naive datetime compared against an aware one (timezone mismatch)
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #3398 on branch fix/silent-drop-2
- **Outcome**: The backlog cleared 66 minutes after deploy
- **Stack**: Python
- **Test Coverage**: tests/notifications/test_dispatch.py

### Occasion 2: 2026-08-03 (Retry Loop Bug)
- **File**: notifications/push/dispatch.py
- **Problem**: Silent drop in the dispatcher
- **Reproduction**: Dispatch to a device token that was rotated
- **Signal**: A send that reports success with no delivery
- **Trigger**: Only appeared for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root Cause**: An unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix**: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- **PR**: #7494 on branch fix/silent-drop-4
- **Outcome**: Cold start dropped 71 percent, to 168 ms
- **Stack**: Python
- **Test Coverage**: tests/notifications/test_dispatch.py

Both issues manifested with identical symptoms but had completely different root causes and required separate fixes deployed 3 months apart."}
